mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE u.user_id=#{id}
mapper.sql:
ORDER BY
u.user_id ${sortDir} u.user_nm ${sortDir}, u.user_id (SELECT min(r.sort_ord) FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur JOIN TB_SY_ROLE r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id) ${sortDir} NULLS LAST, u.user_nm, u.user_id u.user_stat_cd ${sortDir}, u.user_nm, u.user_id u.last_login_dttm ${sortDir} NULLS LAST, u.user_nm, u.user_id u.user_nm, u.user_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_SY_USER u LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT r.role_id FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE r WHERE r.user_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.role_id
SELECT r.role_nm FROM TB_SY_ROLE r JOIN TB_SY_USER_ROLE ur ON ur.role_id=r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.role_id

SELECT names.part_nm FROM ( SELECT p.part_nm FROM TB_BS_PART p JOIN TB_BS_PART_STD s ON s.part_id=p.part_id WHERE s.part_ldr_user_id=#{id} AND s.aply_bgn_ym <= to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','YYYYMM') AND (s.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR s.aply_end_ym >= to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','YYYYMM')) UNION SELECT p.part_nm FROM TB_BS_PART p JOIN TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s ON s.part_id=p.part_id WHERE s.user_id=#{id} AND s.scope_type_cd='PART' AND p.hq_yn='Y' ) names ORDER BY names.part_nm

SELECT DISTINCT p.part_nm FROM TB_BS_PART p JOIN TB_BS_PART_STD s ON s.part_id=p.part_id WHERE s.part_ldr_user_id=#{id} AND (s.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR s.aply_end_ym >= to_char(clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul','YYYYMM')) ORDER BY p.part_nm
SELECT p.part_id FROM TB_BS_PART p WHERE p.hq_yn='Y' AND p.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY p.part_id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s JOIN TB_BS_PART p ON p.part_id=s.part_id WHERE s.user_id=#{id} AND s.scope_type_cd='PART' AND p.hq_yn='Y')
SELECT DISTINCT p.proj_id, p.proj_nm FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p JOIN TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s ON s.proj_id=p.proj_id WHERE s.user_id=#{id} AND s.scope_type_cd='PROJ' ORDER BY p.proj_nm, p.proj_id

SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id, p.proj_id, p.proj_nm FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.proj_id=s.proj_id JOIN TB_SY_USER_ROLE r ON r.user_id=s.user_id AND r.role_id='PM' WHERE s.scope_type_cd='PROJ' AND s.user_id != #{id} AND s.proj_id IN #{project} ORDER BY s.user_id, p.proj_id
SELECT count(*) FROM TB_SY_USER u WHERE u.user_stat_cd='USE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SY_USER_ROLE r WHERE r.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_id='ADMIN')

SELECT l.act_dttm, COALESCE(c.code_nm,l.act_type_cd) AS action, COALESCE(l.trgt_desc,'') AS trgt_desc FROM TB_SY_ACCS_LOG l LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.code_grp_id='ACT_TYPE' AND c.code=l.act_type_cd WHERE l.user_id=#{id} ORDER BY l.act_dttm DESC, l.log_id DESC LIMIT #{filter.pageSize} OFFSET #{filter.offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM TB_SY_ACCS_LOG l WHERE l.user_id=#{id}

SELECT h.reg_dttm, h.chg_item_nm, h.bfr_val, h.aft_val, COALESCE(w.user_nm, h.reg_user_id) AS changed_by FROM TB_SY_CHG_HIST h LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER w ON w.user_id=h.reg_user_id WHERE h.trgt_tbl_nm IN ('TB_SY_USER','TB_SY_USER_ROLE','TB_SY_USER_SCOPE') AND (h.trgt_key=#{id} OR h.trgt_key LIKE #{id} || ':%') ORDER BY h.reg_dttm DESC, h.hist_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SY_USER SET user_nm=#{name}, email_addr=#{email} WHERE user_id=#{id}
UPDATE TB_SY_USER SET WHERE user_id=#{id} AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{token,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
UPDATE TB_SY_USER SET pwd_hash=#{hash},temp_pwd_yn='Y', WHERE user_id=#{id} AND mod_dttm IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{token,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE WHERE user_id=#{id} AND scope_type_cd='PROJ' AND proj_id=#{project}
DELETE FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s USING TB_BS_PART p WHERE s.user_id=#{id} AND s.scope_type_cd='PART' AND s.part_id=p.part_id AND p.hq_yn='Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SY_USER_SCOPE (user_id,scope_sn,scope_type_cd,part_id,proj_id,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) SELECT #{id}, COALESCE(MAX(s.scope_sn),0)+1, #{type}, #{value},NULLNULL,#{value}, 'admin',clock_timestamp() FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s WHERE s.user_id=#{id}
